Scale: the plate spans about 450 px across in the photo. If it is a standard 26 cm dinner plate, that gives about 0.058 cm per px.

Zucchini and yellow squash: the pieces are half-moon slices about 0.5–0.7 cm thick. I count roughly 5 green slices and 5 yellow slices, and each weighs about 12–15 g. That comes to about 10 × 13 g = 130 g, which I split into 70 g zucchini and 60 g yellow squash.

Pizza: the piece measures about 200 px by 120 px, which is roughly 11 cm by 7 cm. It looks like a thin-crust square slice about 1.2 cm thick. Volume is about 11 × 7 × 1.2 ≈ 92 cm³, and at a density of around 0.6 g/cm³ that is about 55 g. I'll estimate 60 g.
